note: LA.18c (programme A5.9). Phoenix: the endpoint mounts `socket "/socket", AppWeb.UserSocket`; the socket routes topics with `channel "room:*", AppWeb.RoomChannel`; the JS client does `new Socket("/socket")` then `socket.channel("room:lobby")`. A trailing `*` in a Phoenix topic pattern matches any suffix of that topic. Baseline 2026-09-18 (HEAD 7a4883b): `channel "` and `use Phoenix.Channel` mint only the generic ws:ws / ws:default, and no JS Phoenix client needle exists; cell reads none. Re-measured 2026-09-19 at HEAD 140024f before the fix: 3 nodes XX, 2 edges XX, FORBID VIOLATIONS 1 (ws:default matched=1). LA.18c reads the literal after `socket "` (gate Phoenix.Endpoint) and `channel "` (gate Phoenix.Socket), phoenix.js `new Socket(` / `.channel(`, and the resolver pairs a trailing-`*` topic by prefix (counted wildcard).
